lessons.title: CSS Kya Hai?
lessons.explanation:
HTML website ka structure banata hai, aur CSS usko sundar banati hai. Socho HTML ek ghar hai aur CSS us ghar ka paint, furniture aur decoration.

CSS ke bina website kaam to karegi, lekin dekhne me simple lagegi.
lessons.mini_task: Blue ki jagah red ya green likho aur difference dekho.
lessons.why_it_matters: Professional websites ka look CSS se hi banta hai.

lessons.title: Colors Aur Background
lessons.explanation:
CSS se text aur page dono ka color badal sakte ho. Sahi colors website ko attractive aur readable banate hain.

Simple colors se start karo, baad me gradients aur themes bhi seekhoge.
lessons.mini_task: Background aur text ka apna favourite color try karo.
lessons.why_it_matters: Har website branding aur readability ke liye colors use karti hai.

lessons.title: Fonts Aur Text Styling
lessons.explanation:
Font aur text styling se content padhna easy ho jata hai. Achha typography user experience improve karta hai.

Har text ko bada ya bold banana zaroori nahi. Balance rakhna best practice hai.
lessons.mini_task: Heading aur paragraph ka font-size change karke dekho.
lessons.why_it_matters: Blogs, portfolios aur business websites sab typography par depend karti hain.

lessons.title: Margin Aur Padding
lessons.explanation:
Margin element ke bahar ki space hoti hai. Padding element ke andar ki space hoti hai.

Ye dono use karke website clean aur organized dikhti hai.
lessons.mini_task: Margin aur padding ki values badal kar layout ka difference dekho.
lessons.why_it_matters: Clean spacing professional design ki pehchan hoti hai.

lessons.title: Borders Aur Border Radius
lessons.explanation:
Border kisi element ke around line banata hai. Border-radius se corners gol ho jate hain.

Modern websites me rounded corners kaafi common hain.
lessons.mini_task: Border-radius ko 30px karke dekho kya change hota hai.
lessons.why_it_matters: Cards, buttons aur forms me ye properties bahut use hoti hain.

lessons.title: CSS Selectors
lessons.explanation:
Selector batata hai ki CSS kis element par apply hogi. Sabse common selectors hain tag, class aur id.

Class ko baar-baar reuse kar sakte ho, isliye real projects me class zyada use hoti hai.
lessons.mini_task: HTML me class="title" lagao aur color change hota hua dekho.
lessons.why_it_matters: Har CSS project selectors par hi chalta hai.

lessons.title: Flexbox Basics
lessons.explanation:
Flexbox ek modern layout system hai. Isse items ko line me ya center me rakhna bahut easy ho jata hai.

Aaj ki zyada tar websites Flexbox use karti hain.
lessons.mini_task: justify-content ko space-between karke result dekho.
lessons.why_it_matters: Navbar, cards aur buttons align karne ke liye Flexbox bahut important hai.

lessons.title: CSS Grid Basics
lessons.explanation:
Grid ek powerful layout system hai jo rows aur columns me content arrange karta hai.

Complex layouts ke liye Grid best choice hoti hai.
lessons.mini_task: Columns ko 3 karo aur layout ka difference dekho.
lessons.why_it_matters: Gallery, dashboard aur product pages me Grid kaafi use hota hai.

lessons.title: Hover Effects
lessons.explanation:
Hover tab activate hota hai jab mouse kisi element ke upar aata hai. Isse website interactive feel hoti hai.

Mobile par hover kam use hota hai, lekin desktop ke liye useful hai.
lessons.mini_task: Hover par button ka color apni choice ka kar do.
lessons.why_it_matters: Buttons aur links ko interactive banane ke liye hover use hota hai.

lessons.title: Mini Card Design
lessons.explanation:
Ab tak jo seekha hai usko combine karke ek simple card banate hain. Isi tarah real websites me cards bante hain.

Ye ek chhota project hai jo tumhare concepts ko strong karega.
lessons.mini_task: Apne HTML me ek card banao jisme heading, paragraph aur button ho.
lessons.why_it_matters: Portfolio, blog aur e-commerce websites me cards bahut common hote hain.

lessons.title: Header Ko Professional Banana
lessons.story: 🏠 Yaad hai HTML me humne website ka header banaya tha? Ab socho ghar ka gate bina paint aur design ke ho. Kaam to karega, lekin dekhne me khas nahi lagega.
lessons.explanation:
Header website ka pehla impression hota hai. Thoda background color, spacing aur text color add karke ise professional bana sakte ho.

Ab se hum HTML ke banaye hue projects ko CSS se improve karenge.
lessons.mini_task: Header ka background apne favourite color ka karo aur padding ko 30px karke dekho.
lessons.why_it_matters: Har website ka header user sabse pehle dekhta hai.

lessons.title: Navigation Menu Styling
lessons.story: 🧭 Socho mall ke sign boards ka text itna chhota ho ki koi padh hi na sake. Website ke navigation ke saath bhi aisa hi hota hai agar usse style na kiya jaye.
lessons.explanation:
Navigation links ko readable aur clean banana zaroori hai.

Color, spacing aur text-decoration se menu ka look kaafi improve ho jata hai.
lessons.mini_task: Links ka color yellow karo aur margin ko 25px karke dekho.
lessons.why_it_matters: Clean navigation se users website me easily move kar pate hain.

lessons.title: Image Ko Beautiful Banana
lessons.story: 📷 Ek hi photo bina frame ke aur frame ke saath dekho. Frame wali photo zyada attractive lagti hai. CSS image ke liye wahi frame ka kaam karti hai.
lessons.explanation:
Image ko round, border ya shadow dekar uska look improve kiya ja sakta hai.

Ye portfolio aur profile websites me bahut common hai.
lessons.mini_task: Border-radius ko 20px karke dekho aur difference notice karo.
lessons.why_it_matters: Profile photos aur product images ko attractive dikhane ke liye styling zaroori hai.

lessons.title: Table Ko Stylish Banana
lessons.story: 📊 School ka result agar bina lines aur spacing ke ho to padhna mushkil ho jayega. CSS tables ko clean aur readable banati hai.
lessons.explanation:
Table me borders, padding aur alignment add karke data ko samajhna easy ho jata hai.

Professional dashboards aur reports isi tarah design hote hain.
lessons.mini_task: Border ka color blue kar do aur padding ko 15px kar do.
lessons.why_it_matters: Reports, marksheets aur pricing tables me ye styling use hoti hai.

lessons.title: 🎨 Mini Project - Portfolio Ka First Design
lessons.story: 🎉 Ab tum sirf HTML nahi likh rahe, balki usse achha dikhana bhi seekh rahe ho. Ye wahi step hai jahan beginner ki website professional lagni shuru hoti hai.
lessons.explanation:
Ab tak seekhe hue colors, fonts, spacing, borders aur image styling ko ek saath use karo.

Perfect design banana zaroori nahi. Sabse zaroori baat ye hai ki tum khud experiment karo.
lessons.mini_task: Apne HTML portfolio me ek card banao jisme image, heading, paragraph aur button ho.
lessons.why_it_matters: Isi tarah chhote-chhote components milkar professional portfolio aur business websites banti hain.

lessons.title: Form Ko Professional Look Dena
lessons.story: 📝 Socho tum kisi website par signup karne jaate ho aur input boxes bahut chhote aur ajeeb dikhte hain. Shayad tum form bharne ka mann hi na karo. Achha design user ka trust badhata hai.
lessons.explanation:
HTML me humne form banaya tha. Ab CSS se uske input aur button ko clean aur modern look denge.

Forms me spacing aur size bahut important hote hain, taki user aaram se information bhar sake.
lessons.mini_task: Input ka border-radius 8px karo aur button ko blue background do.
lessons.why_it_matters: Login, Signup aur Contact forms har web application ka important hissa hote hain.

lessons.title: Buttons Ko Interactive Banana
lessons.story: 🖱️ Socho tum lift ka button dabate ho aur usme koi change hi nahi dikhta. Tumhe lagega shayad button kaam nahi kar raha. Website ke buttons ke saath bhi aisa hi hota hai.
lessons.explanation:
Hover aur transition se button zyada responsive aur professional lagta hai.

Ye chhota sa effect user ko batata hai ki button clickable hai.
lessons.mini_task: Hover par button ka background green kar do aur text white rakho.
lessons.why_it_matters: Interactive buttons user experience ko better banate hain.

lessons.title: Shadow Aur Modern Cards
lessons.story: 📦 Ek box table par rakho aur doosra box halka sa shadow ke saath. Shadow wala box zyada premium aur real lagta hai.
lessons.explanation:
CSS ka box-shadow cards aur images ko depth deta hai.

Aaj ki almost har modern website cards aur shadows ka use karti hai.
lessons.mini_task: Shadow ki value badhao aur dekho card ka look kaise change hota hai.
lessons.why_it_matters: Dashboards, portfolios aur e-commerce websites me cards bahut common hote hain.

lessons.title: Responsive Design - Mobile Ke Liye
lessons.story: 📱 Socho tumne laptop ke liye website banayi, lekin mobile me sab kuch bahar nikal gaya. Aaj ke time me mobile users sabse zyada hote hain.
lessons.explanation:
Responsive design ka matlab hai website har screen size par achhi dikhe.

Media Query CSS ka modern feature hai jo screen size ke hisaab se style change karta hai.
lessons.mini_task: Mobile ke liye paragraph ka font-size 16px kar do.
lessons.why_it_matters: Professional websites desktop aur mobile dono par achhi dikhni chahiye.

lessons.title: 🎨 Mini Project - Responsive Portfolio
lessons.story: 🚀 Ab tumhari HTML website sirf chalti hi nahi, balki achhi bhi dikhti hai. Ye beginner se frontend developer banne ka pehla bada step hai.
lessons.explanation:
Ab tak seekhe hue colors, spacing, Flexbox, shadows aur responsive design ko ek saath use karo.

Project complete karne ke baad apni website mobile aur desktop dono me check karo.
lessons.mini_task: Apne portfolio me 3 cards banao jo mobile me neeche aur desktop me side-by-side dikhai den.
lessons.why_it_matters: Responsive portfolio tumhare future projects aur freelance work ki strong foundation ban sakta hai.

lessons.title: Clean CSS - Achhe Developer Ki Pehchan
lessons.story: 👨‍💻 Do developers ne ek hi website banayi. Pehle ne CSS ko random jagah likha, isliye baad me kuch bhi change karna mushkil ho gaya. Dusre ne classes aur comments ka sahi use kiya, isliye uska project aasani se update ho gaya.
lessons.explanation:
CSS sirf likhna hi nahi, usse organize rakhna bhi zaroori hai. Similar styles ko ek jagah rakho aur meaningful class names use karo.

Jab project bada hota hai, clean CSS tumhara bahut time bachati hai.
lessons.mini_task: Apni purani CSS file me class names ko aur meaningful banao.
lessons.why_it_matters: Companies clean aur maintainable CSS ko professional skill maanti hain.

lessons.title: Accessibility Friendly CSS
lessons.story: 🌍 Socho kisi user ki aankhen kamzor hain. Agar text aur background ka color same jaisa ho, to wo website padh hi nahi payega.
lessons.explanation:
Achha design sirf sundar nahi hota, balki padhne me bhi easy hota hai. Text aur background ke beech achha contrast rakho.

Bahut chhota font ya low-contrast colors avoid karo.
lessons.mini_task: Dark background aur white text wala version bhi bana kar dekho.
lessons.why_it_matters: Accessible websites zyada log use kar sakte hain aur user experience improve hota hai.

lessons.title: HTML + CSS Ek Saath Kaise Kaam Karte Hain?
lessons.story: 🍕 Pizza ka base bina toppings ke adhura lagta hai, aur toppings bina base ke. HTML aur CSS bhi isi tarah ek team ki tarah kaam karte hain.
lessons.explanation:
HTML content deta hai aur CSS us content ko style karti hai. Jab tum HTML me class dete ho, CSS us class ko target karke design apply karti hai.

Ye connection samajhna frontend development ka sabse important step hai.
lessons.mini_task: HTML me `class="title"` wali heading banao aur us par ye CSS apply karo.
lessons.why_it_matters: Har frontend project me HTML aur CSS saath-saath kaam karte hain.

lessons.title: Mini Project - Landing Page Design
lessons.story: 🚀 Socho kisi ne tumhari website pehli baar kholi. Sirf 5 second me wo decide karega ki rukna hai ya nahi. Isi liye first impression bahut important hota hai.
lessons.explanation:
Ab tak seekhe hue colors, spacing, Flexbox, images, buttons aur cards ka use karke ek simple landing page design karo.

Focus sirf design ko clean aur readable rakhne par rakho.
lessons.mini_task: Ek Hero section banao jisme heading, paragraph aur 'Get Started' button ho.
lessons.why_it_matters: Landing pages startups, products aur business websites ka common part hoti hain.

lessons.title: 🏆 CSS Course Complete - Final Portfolio Challenge
lessons.story: 🎉 Jab tumne Lesson 1 shuru kiya tha tab sirf text ka color badalte the. Ab tum ek clean, responsive aur modern-looking website design kar sakte ho. Ye tumhari frontend journey ka ek bada milestone hai.
lessons.explanation:
Ab bina notes dekhe apni complete portfolio website design karne ki koshish karo. Jahan problem aaye, wahi tumhari next practice hai.

Iske baad JavaScript seekhne par tum apni static website ko interactive bana paoge.
lessons.mini_task: Apne HTML portfolio ko final design do. Header, Navigation, Hero Section, About, Skills, Projects, Contact Form aur Footer ko responsive banao. Mobile aur desktop dono par check karo.
lessons.why_it_matters: Ye project tumhare learning portfolio ka pehla complete frontend project ban sakta hai aur JavaScript seekhne ke liye strong foundation tayyar karega.
